Yellow legal sheet titled 'UH, THAT'S CHRISTMAS NANA' (Has anyone seen my apron?).

cards.words_verdict: TYPED WORDS INCLUDE A SHEET NOT PICTURED
cards.words_note: First part (Never again) matches photo 1. The 'fingers and toes in the cracks of the dam' fragment and 'United We Stand / All for one and one for all' are on no photo here. Photo 2 'Uh, That's Christmas Nana' is not in the typed words shown (text cut at check limit).
cards.other_problems: Photo 2 is a different poem (Christmas Nana) on yellow legal paper but carries the same 131 blocks; its words are not typed in the visible text. Summary 'heavy crossouts' does not fit photo 1 (only one small crossout).

photos.what_it_shows: White lined sheet, bubble-letter title 'a dime a dozen', black ink.

cards.words_verdict: TYPED WORDS INCLUDE A SHEET NOT PICTURED
cards.words_note: First part (a dime a dozen) matches the photo. Second part 'I must be strong, I'll see her next week ... Captivation is my motivation' is on no photo here.
cards.other_problems: Summary contradicts the photo: it says YELLOW LEGAL PAD, 4 shots, red ink, dated 6/28-29/2003, signed, 'THIS BELONGS ON THE FRIDGE!', 'Mommy's Gift to Daughter'. Photo is one white lined sheet in black ink with none of that.

photos.what_it_shows: Lined sheet 'SUCKING THE LIFE' shot sideways; writing runs up the screen, blocks stacked in a column on the left (read bottom to top 1-3-9).

photos.what_it_shows: White loose-leaf sheet, no title, 'Yes I was once a child many years ago', bracketed chorus 'As soon as I'm high something brings me down'.

cards.words_verdict: TYPED WORDS INCLUDE A SHEET NOT PICTURED
cards.words_note: First part (Yes I was once a child ... what I loved so much I want it back) matches. The whole 'ALL OR NOTHING' song after the --- is on no photo here.
cards.name_note: 'ALL OR NOTHING' is not on the pictured sheet. Should be 'YES I WAS ONCE A CHILD' (first line) or hook 'AS SOON AS I'M HIGH'.
cards.other_problems: Summary 'spiral, two-color (black + green ink), crinkled' does not fit the photo: hole-punched loose leaf, one ink colour.
